eligibility: exactly two threshold clicks across all twelve returned modes, one on a control rail (modes 0, 1) and one on a target rail (modes 2, 3)

outcomes.meaning: control rail then target rail of the click

compilation_seeds.rule: nonzero draw values in index order, repeats skipped: 4 anchor seeds in anchor order, then 10 seeds per ensemble setting in setting order (seed index s = 1..10, s <= 5 in job-00), then the analysis Monte Carlo seed, then the false-alarm study seed; the order keys are the raw values of the next 176 indices; the three indices after them seed the bootstrap of the tomography prediction, the random-map check of the bound and the test fixtures

billing: a completed job bills 1 credit plus the platform's price per billed shot (1e-6 on qpu:ascella and qpu:belenos), and a completed iterated job bills the smaller of the shots it used and its largest iteration's max_shots; an isolated usage report gives the charge where one exists, a job canceled before its start bills nothing, and the cap bills in full only when neither a usage report nor a shots-used figure gives the charge (qd_platform.job_billing and qd_platform.charged, docs/runbooks/quandela-credit-optimization.md section 'The billing rule'); a credit figure computed at max_shots is the job's ceiling

preregistered.observable: two complementary truth tables (Hofmann, PRL 94, 160504 (2005)): ZX reads control Z and target X for |0,+>, |0,->, |1,+>, |1,->; XZ reads control X and target Z for |+,0>, |-,0>, |+,1>, |-,1>; each setting's correct outcome is the one its ideal CZ output returns with probability 1
preregistered.rates: eligible rate = eligible events over the iteration's nb_shots_used; correct rate = the events on the correct outcome over the same shots
preregistered.primary: rate-weighted score F_T(s) = sum over the four inputs of table T of the correct rates at seed index s over the sum of their eligible rates
preregistered.descriptive: per-input score F'_T(s) = mean over the four inputs of correct over eligible events
preregistered.binding: each run's cases.json equals the retained case byte for byte and the two runs are distinct jobs; an ensemble iteration binds one to one to the setting whose compilation_seed it echoes, an anchor iteration to its anchor's seed group, which must hold exactly five per job; every iteration echoes its setting's circuit_params. The five members of an anchor group are labeled in returned order, which proves no physical chronology; no statistic below depends on that label, since a homogeneity table is invariant under permuting its rows
preregistered.preconditions: both runs complete, and every one of the 120 iterations returns counts and carries at least 200 eligible events; otherwise the case is undecided
preregistered.homogeneity_test: Pearson chi-square of an R x 4 table of eligible outcome counts against the pooled row proportions (columns with no events dropped); Monte Carlo p = (1 + b) / (1 + 100000), b the number of 100000 tables drawn uniformly over the arrangements with the observed row and column totals (sequential hypergeometric draws, the exact conditional null) whose statistic reaches the observed one
preregistered.rate_test: conditional binomial comparison of an anchor's per-shot eligible rate between the jobs: given k0 + k1, k0 ~ Binomial(k0 + k1, n0 / (n0 + n1)) with n the summed nb_shots_used, two-sided; this is the Poisson-rate form, and under the stopping rule (fixed samples, random shots) its variance ratio is 1 - p_eligible / p_any_click, about 0.996 at the forecast, so it is slightly conservative
preregistered.estimate_1_drift: per anchor: positions in job-00, positions in job-01, job-00 against job-01 (homogeneity) and the rate test; the jobs pool only when all 16 p-values exceed 0.01 / 16 and every anchor iteration returns a computed_circuit, one digest per anchor across both jobs; a missing or empty computed_circuit unpools the jobs
preregistered.estimate_2_mesh_variance: per ensemble setting, homogeneity of its ten seed tables at 0.01 / 8 when the jobs pool, else of each job's five seed tables at 0.01 / 16, so a shift between jobs never reads as mesh variance; the between-seed variance of its correct fraction minus the mean binomial variance is reported as the excess, and seeds that return one computed_circuit are reported as one mesh
preregistered.estimate_3_scores: mean over s of F_T(s) with a two-sided 0.95 Student-t interval on 9 degrees of freedom when the jobs pool, else per job on 4; the same for F'_T. The seed index s pairs the four settings of a table arbitrarily, each setting's replicates being placed by independent order keys; time drift between s adds variance the interval carries. The interval's coverage under a non-normal mesh distribution is not established
preregistered.estimate_4_bound: L = one-sided 0.975 lower limit of the mean of F_ZX(s) + F_XZ(s) - 1, U = the smaller one-sided 0.9875 upper limit of F_ZX and F_XZ; reported only when the jobs pool, as a statement conditional on one process for every setting and one chance of a shot per attempt
preregistered.estimate_5_tomography: each ensemble score minus the score that the retained unprojected tomography fit predicts for the same settings (forecast.json tomography_prediction); the interval combines estimate 3's standard error with the standard deviation of the prediction over a parametric bootstrap of the tomography runs (500 replicates, tomo.resampled_rates), at the Student-t quantile of estimate 3; the predicted rates are linear images of an unprojected fit and can be negative
preregistered.hom: each plan's HOM minus the HOM at which the tomography's job-00 was submitted (its submission.json perfs_at_plan); hom_moved is true beyond 1.0 point

readings.both_differences_contain_zero: the single-compilation tomography fit predicts the ensemble's truth tables
readings.difference_above_zero: the ensemble reads that table better than the tomography fit predicts
readings.difference_below_zero: the tomography fit overstated that table, by mesh selection or by its estimator
readings.mesh_variance_rejects: the tomography interval, which covers shot noise only, is too narrow for the mesh ensemble
readings.drift_or_recalibration: the jobs are reported separately and no pooled bound is claimed
readings.hom_moved: the plan's HOM differs from the tomography's by more than 1.0 point: estimate 5 states the HOM difference beside each comparison

hom_percent.reference_source: HOM at which the tomography's job-00 was submitted (its submission.json perfs_at_plan)

submission_policy.statuses: Explorer row and processor read available or running, while the token counts no running, no queued and no running quantum-task job (qd_platform.require_token_capacity refuses a busy token at either status)
submission_policy.live_read: a processor read inside the submit lock, after the plan, equals the plan's perfs, connects source modes [0, 2], and forecasts at least 200 eligible events in every setting's iteration at its max_shots

after.requires: a collected run of job-00 that completed with 60 bound iterations, none uncounted, each with at least 200 eligible events
